name: Kiro changelog
title: IDE: Approve for Me and Chat Permission Modes
headline: Kiro adds Approve for Me permission mode
lede: In Kiro chat, the agent can approve routine actions for you, block risky ones and ask when unsure.

effects.effect: Permission modes become standard in agent IDEs
Risk classification moves into the agent loop

possibilities.title: Scriptable security review in CI gets a graded human gate for routine fixes

with.title: OpenAI Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK

possibilities.connection: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI finds, validates and fixes vulnerabilities from CI, and Kiro's Approve for Me grades which actions run automatically, so low-risk fixes can land while risky ones wait for a person.

appearances.newly_possible: In Kiro chat, the agent can approve routine actions for you, block risky ones and ask when unsure.
appearances.why: Graded permission modes reduce approval fatigue without giving agents full autopilot.
